evals.name: missing_brief_requires_qna
assertions: Asks for the Lab or starter-repository link
Asks whether the Lab is individual or team work
Asks for the deliverable and verification or rubric
Does not produce a Markdown Lab before the missing brief is answered
Does not invent a repository, test, or deadline

evals.name: confirmed_individual_lab
evals.prompt: Viết ngay Lab cá nhân Day 03. Repo https://github.com/example/rag-starter, deliverable là README.md và chạy pytest tests -v; rubric pass toàn bộ test.
assertions: Produces Vietnamese Markdown with a title and at least one ## section
Preserves the supplied repository link and pytest command
States the individual work mode and exact deliverable
Uses concrete actions and checkable completion signals
Does not add unsupported APIs, files, or test results

evals.name: confirmed_day_is_written_for_studio
evals.prompt: Viết ngay Lab cá nhân Day 21. Brief, repo, deliverable và cách kiểm tra đã chốt.
assertions: Uses YAML front matter with the exact canonical value day: "D21"
Keeps the confirmed Day consistent with the title and learner-facing body
Does not invent a different Day or omit the known Day from YAML

evals.name: team_lab_needs_submission_policy
evals.prompt: Tạo Lab nhóm Day 05 với repo đã gửi, mỗi nhóm 3 người.
assertions: Asks for roles and whether submission is per team or per learner
Asks for the deliverable and assessment facts
Does not invent a grading rubric or submission destination

evals.name: submission_default_requires_explicit_opt_out
evals.prompt: Viết Lab chỉ đọc tài liệu, không có artifact để nộp. Brief đã chốt.
assertions: Uses the unquoted YAML boolean requiresSubmission: false or explains why it is omitted
Does not describe a fictional submission destination
Keeps at least one ## section and a leading # title when no YAML is used

evals.name: yaml_and_team_body_agree
evals.prompt: Viết ngay Lab nhóm Day 04. Nhóm 3 người: researcher, builder, reviewer; một link nộp cho mỗi nhóm; repo và rubric đã gửi.
assertions: Uses only supported metadata keys and a valid workMode: team value when front matter is used
States the confirmed team size, roles, and one-link submission policy in the learner-facing body
Does not add unknown metadata, unsupported course facts, or invented tests

evals.name: review_is_observable_and_source_faithful
evals.prompt: Review Lab này: 'Khám phá công cụ mạnh mẽ. ## Nội dung Hãy làm bài.' Không có repo, command, hoặc rubric được cung cấp.
assertions: Reports location, visible issue, and a minimal source-faithful revision or focused question
Does not claim the text is AI-written
Does not fabricate commands, files, outcomes, or a submission policy

evals.name: private_github_source_uses_gh_without_token
evals.prompt: Soạn Lab từ https://github.com/acme/course/blob/main/labs/day-03.md. Raw content bị 404 vì repo private.
assertions: Tries the exact raw source before using gh api for the same owner, repo, path, and ref
Checks gh auth status and never requests or exposes a token
Asks the owner to authenticate or confirm access when gh retrieval fails
Does not clone the repository or guess another branch or Markdown file

evals.name: github_lab_is_explained_as_a_connected_walkthrough
evals.prompt: Từ file GitHub đã xác nhận có hướng dẫn mở template.py, chạy pytest tests -v, rồi nộp solution.zip, hãy viết Lab cho người mới.
assertions: Explains how each source-backed phase contributes to the final artifact before or alongside the ordered actions
Uses readable complete Vietnamese sentences and natural transitions instead of only terse command bullets
States source-backed expected observations after commands without inventing output or architecture
Preserves the named file, command, and submission artifact exactly

evals.name: reader_first_prose_is_not_a_chopped_checklist
evals.prompt: Brief đã chốt: người mới cần mở template.py, chạy pytest tests -v, sửa TODO và nộp solution.zip. Hãy viết phần hướng dẫn Lab.
assertions: Introduces each action cluster with a short, complete explanation of why it matters to the confirmed outcome
Explains a new term only at the decision point where the learner needs it
States a source-backed observation after the command and uses it to connect to the next action
Does not turn every line into an imperative fragment or invent a story, output, or technical rationale

evals.name: substantive_steps_explain_before_acting
evals.prompt: Brief đã chốt: Lab Day 21 có bước kiểm tra loss mask, đóng băng baseline, train LoRA và đánh giá bốn nhóm. Viết một section kỹ thuật cho người mới.
assertions: Uses 500–1,000 words of learner-facing prose for the substantive technical section, excluding code and tables
Explains the underlying question before the ordered actions
Breaks down any term needed to make the decision in the Lab context
Gives a source-backed checkpoint and explains why it enables the next step
Does not pad the section with repeated goals, generic theory, or invented details

evals.name: technical_step_explains_design_tradeoffs_without_inventing
evals.prompt: Brief đã chốt: hàm compare_models nhận một prompt, gọi hai model và trả về response, latency cùng ước tính chi phí. Source chỉ yêu cầu giữ đúng năm key trong dict; không giải thích vì sao công thức chi phí được chọn. Viết section kỹ thuật cho người mới.
assertions: Uses 500–1,000 words of learner-facing prose excluding code and tables
Explains the function responsibility, inputs, outputs, and why preserving the dictionary contract matters
Explains source-backed benefits and limits of the comparison
Does not invent a rationale for the supplied cost formula or claim one model is universally better
Connects a checkable result to the next learner decision

evals.name: github_repo_is_read_before_work_mode_confirmation
assertions: Reads the default-branch README as the initial source rather than opening with a generic questionnaire
Returns a source-derived brief with the source link and work-mode evidence
Infers individual work only as an inference when evidence includes a per-student identifier or personal reflection
Asks the user to confirm or correct that one work-mode inference
